_doc: Variant INDEX. Each group owns a set of entry ids across sections of a storey JSON; loading a variant removes ALL ids owned by the group (from any of its variants) and inserts the chosen variant's items. The items live one file per variant in data/variants/<group>/<variant>.json. CLI: uv run python src/variant.py list | show <group> <variant> | load <group> <variant> | save <group> <variant>
